subject: roseate spoonbill with young
creator: Z. Z.
alt: A bright pink adult roseate spoonbill spreads its wings among branches as three paler young crowd toward its open bill.
detail: Adult and young bill contact, reaching necks, wings and branches support the feeding scene. Maternal identity, earlier size comparison and the pause afterward are fiction. Source adult sex and offspring relationships are not independently established by the photograph.
